text: The focused follow-up adds linux64-7zz to the repackage task, alongside mar-tools and upx. The accepted task uses a Linux worker while its package formats vary by build target, including Windows installers. That fetch is separate from earlier build-task toolchains; declaration alone does not prove a fetch or package operation succeeded.
title: Repackage declares its own Linux-host 7zz input
